system.description:
A gemstone-studded chest with a 1.5-foot cubic interior. It has 20 charges. As an Action, touch the closed lid and spend 1 charge while naming one or more nonmagical objects worth 1g or less total - they appear inside, provided they fit and the chest is otherwise empty. Food and drink conjured this way are delicious but spoil after 24 Hours; conjured gems or precious metals crumble to nothing after 1 Minute.

The chest regains 1d20 charges each dawn. If its last charge is ever spent, roll a d20 - on a 1, it loses its magic for good and its gems turn to dust.
system.lore: An abracadabrus never runs in the same family twice - the ones that survive tend to end up in the hands of merchants clever enough not to ask for soup twice in one day.
